What’s covered?Carrier liabilityShipping insurance

Common questions about shipping insurance

Learn how shipping insurance works, what may be covered, and which option could fit your business.

InsureShield® is a shipping insurance program underwritten through UPS Capital Insurance Agency, Inc. It covers the full insured value of your shipments against loss, damage, and porch pirated theft (across UPS®, FedEx®, DHL®, USPS®, and other LTL and multimodal carriers) with most claims resolved within 5 business days.

InsureShield® covers loss, damage, and porch piracy up to the full sales value of your shipment, including original shipping costs. Expedited reshipping reimbursement is also available for qualifying shipments. Coverage is available for domestic and international shipments depending on jurisdiction.

Carrier liability, such as UPS® or FedEx® declared value, is not insurance. It is governed by each carrier’s published terms, limits, and exclusions. InsureShield® is shipping insurance that provides broader protection for eligible shipments and can be customized to meet your business’s needs, including specialty coverage options. Most claims are paid in days, not weeks. Coverage and claim payments are subject to the applicable policy terms.

Yes. Customers can opt into InsureShield® shipping protection when they complete their purchase. The cost of coverage is presented separately at checkout and paid by the customer, while your business gains another way to address eligible lost or damaged shipments. It integrates easily with Shopify carts and other ecommerce platforms via API.

Claims can be filed online through the InsureShield® claims portal. You will need the shipment tracking number, the insured value, and documentation of the loss or damage (photos, carrier notification, etc.). Most claims are processed in a matter of days. InsureShield® customers have access to direct communication with a claims specialist.

Yes, InsureShield® shipping insurance supports eligible domestic and international shipments. InsureShield® shipping insurance may be available to eligible businesses in Ontario, with availability in additional Canadian provinces planned for 2027. Options are also available in select international markets, including the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Hong Kong. Availability varies by jurisdiction, shipping route, shipment type, and applicable policy terms.

*Expedited reshipping reimbursement provided up to 20% of the insured value of the goods.

Insurance coverage is underwritten by an authorized insurance company and issued through licensed insurance producers, including UPS Capital Insurance Agency, Inc. (“UPSCIA”), a subsidiary of UPS Capital Corporation. The insurance company, UPSCIA and its licensed affiliates reserve the right to change or cancel the program at any time. This information does not in any way alter or amend the terms, limitations or exclusions of the applicable insurance policy or program. Insurance coverage is not available in all jurisdictions.

Unless otherwise noted, all statistics used herein are derived from or based on information contained in the 2023 Platform Research, which is based on a compilation of two independent studies conducted by Evalueserve in December 2023 of 1,245 U.S. SMB owners and decision makers whose businesses report $250K - $100M in revenue.

Statistics in our social media advertising are based on aggregated insurance product data collected by UPS Capital Insurance Agency, Inc. during the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters ending the prior calendar year. Individual results may vary.

This website uses cookies and analytics technologies

We do this to better understand how visitors use our site and to offer you a more personal experience. By using our website, you consent to the recording, use, and sharing of your website activity by us and our service providers. For more information, please visit our Privacy Notice

Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser about you or your device, mostly in the form of cookies. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Social Media Cookies

These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.

Analytics Cookies

These cookies allow us to analyze your use of the website to gain valuable insights and make performance improvements. They allow us to view a simulation of your browsing experience based on button clicks, mouse movements, scrolls, window resizing, touches (on mobile) keystrokes, page navigation, page source, page ID and error messages. These cookies are provided by third parties and will be used for troubleshooting purposes, customer support or to improve the performance and design of the website. Some cookies are used to generate research surveys and other methods of gaining insight from you and may be targeted. Participation is optional. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less surveys and limit our ability to optimize your experience.

Personalization Cookies

Our website uses cookies to offer you a personalized experience. If you choose to accept these cookies, we (or our 3rd party partners) may collect and share data about your actions on our site. To learn more or update your preferences, click 'Cookie Settings'—also available anytime at the bottom of the page.
